description: This header file declares functions and data structures for reading and writing kernel log events within the 'cuttlefish::monitor' namespace, utilizing JSON serialization and shared file descriptors.

methods.name: ReadEvent
methods.description: Reads a kernel log event from a file descriptor, returning a Result containing an optional ReadEventResult. An error result indicates a read failure, while an empty optional indicates EOF.

methods.name: WriteEvent
methods.description: Writes a kernel log event to a file descriptor in a format compatible with ReadEvent.
